arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Blatt stated the removal statute gives defendants the same federal court rights as plaintiffs.
Mr. Hament noted defendants have had this removal right since 1875.
Mr. Pinaud argued removal jurisdiction must be construed narrowly based on prior precedent.
